profile.headline: Software Engineer at L3 Harris
profile.summary:
Software engineer with an active secret clearance and extensive experience in both hardware and software design.  Knowledgeable in software development life cycle and methodologies including Agile development process.  In-depth knowledge of Rust, C/C++, Python, and Bash.  Working knowledge of Java and Matlab.  In-depth knowledge of many networking protocols and standards including TCP, UDP, IP, 802.1X, Ethernet, and HLDC.  Able to troubleshoot both hardware and software at all levels.

Specialties: 
- Embedded Systems
- Object Oriented Software design in UML, C++ and Java
- Computer Network

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and test HAIPE software using Rust 
- Modify UBoot to use custom Rust based signature verification algorithm and verify operation on Qemu 
- Use Tokio to send messages between asynchronous tasks using mpsc channels
- Convert legacy C++ to Rust and refactor Rust code for performance and testability 
- Implement Rust FFI to process configuration updates in YANG modules via RESTCONF

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and test real-time flight software on Linux using C++
- Develop Linux user space I/O software to transfer serial data to the FPGA over PCIe using C/C++
- Implement unit test cases for existing software using gTest and gMock
- Develop Linux C++11 software to send raw video to FPGA for display

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and test real-time flight software on LynxOS using C++
- Implement software using multiple threads to process second IMU data for performance improvement
-  Measure and document prototype software for network latency improvement

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop, optimize, and test CDS software on Embedded Linux in multiple programming languages
- Implement synchronized concurrent tasks to process data simultaneously in Ada2012
- Profile, analyze, and refactor CSharp code for improve network throughput and CPU usage
- Refactor compiled and managed code for 2X performance at the same CPU usage
- Create performance analysis framework in Python to measure multi-protocol network performance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implement, update, and troubleshoot new and legacy HWIL software on CentOS Linux
- Implement event-driven, multithreaded, framework to process asynchronous UDP packets in C++11
- Create C++11 wrapper around legacy Fortran and C codes to interface with new software
- Troubleshoot and analyze network performance issues using socat and Wireshark
- Refactored code to read JSON file to allow software configuration change without rebuilding software

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop secure HTTP2 client software using Agile development process
- Design and implement C++11 based secure HTTP client and create Python script for verification
- Implement thread safe container/message queues to transfer encrypted key package to HTTP Server
- Configure/incorporate curl, openssl, and other 3rd party opens source libraries to deliverable software
- Setup CMake and Google Test for building and running automated unit tests

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Port, Implement, and update new and legacy HWIL software on RedHawk Linux 
- Port legacy HWIL software for missile testing (Fortran77, C99, and C++98) to 64-bit RedHawk Linux
- Debug and fix networking/serial communication issues using oscilloscope and Wireshark
- Implement test scripts for functional missile target engageability simulations in Python 3

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Write STP/STD for new ACC based crypto algorithm running on secure terminal equipment
- Create Software Test Plan from requirements based on nominal case assumptions and scope
- Verify test cases against software requirements in requirements database 
- Import/update all projects and JTAG Scripts to ARM Development Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Prototype, Implement, and update new and legacy software components in C++11 on embedded Linux 
- Prototype DDS readers/writers to publish and subscribe to periodic BIT Fault data
- Create design documentation using markdown
- Refactor legacy code for use in new framework using C++11
- Update and test numerical computation library using Google Mock and Test

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implement IEEE802.1X-2010 Protocol in C++11 and Boost on embedded Linux 
- Update/implement IEEE 802.1X-2010 protocol on embedded Linux platform
- Participate in Agile Process (Scrum)
- Refactor legacy public/private key algorithm using OpenSSL and Boost C++ Library
- Debug and fix synchronization issues in multi-threaded application on multi-core processor
- Create python based test platform for regression testing

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Create Scade Model Coverage Tests for DO-178B Certification
- Implement new low level requirements in Scade Models and C
- Update Software Design Document and Software Requirement Specification
- Create Klocwork KAST Scripts for code analysis and Perl Script to generate formatted reports

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Create new vxWorks kernel libraries in C and optimize existing libraries on an embedded PowerPC/X86 platform
- Verify/prototype astronomical algorithm using Matlab
- Implement and debug multi-threaded (POSIX/ACE) C++ libraries for distributed system
- Create C++ test cases for vxWorks RTP using VectorCast software for regression testing
- Ported vxWorks 6.4 Power PC 32-bit kernels and RTP over to vxWorks 6.9 x86 64-bit
- Automate testing and installation of software using Perl
- Create portable GUI for monitoring resource usage on an embedded system using Qt/C++

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented cryptographic algorithm in FPGA for space mission telemetry and control device.
- Implemented FPGA based cryptographic key fill device, using VHDL for space mission telemetry and control device.
- Performed signal integrity simulation on DDR-2 interface using Mentor HyperLynx.
- Designed InfiniBand packet management software in C++ from UML class diagram and use cases.
- Integrated commercial off-the shelf libraries into test avionics software using C/C++.
- Automated test process using Perl scripting language.
- Wrote test scripts and procedures for Security Verification Test

projects.title: SOFIA
projects.description: NASA is developing the Stratospheric Observatory for Infrared Astronomy - or SOFIA - as a world-class airborne observatory that will complement the Hubble, Spitzer, Herschel and James Webb space telescopes.
